title: docs: Evaluate @objectstack/client for spec-based low-code app UI
body:
Evaluates whether `@objectstack/client` can fully implement a low-code app UI against the `@objectstack/spec` protocol. Adds detailed evaluation document and updates the roadmap with integration milestones.

**Verdict: 92% coverage (22/24 protocol features) — fully capable.**

### `OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_EVALUATION.md` (new)

- **10 protocol domains assessed**: Data CRUD, Metadata, UI Views, Actions, Auth, Permissions, Multi-Tenancy, Advanced features, Real-time, Offline
- **2 gaps identified**: Real-time collaboration (WebSocket, Q3) and offline sync (Service Worker, Q3)
- End-to-end low-code flow mapped: `defineStack()` → `ObjectStackAdapter` → `SchemaRenderer`
- Reference architecture with code examples for minimal app setup
- Gap analysis with effort estimates and timelines
- Competitive positioning vs Retool/Appsmith/Mendix

### `ROADMAP.md` updates

- **New section**: `@objectstack/client Evaluation Summary` with domain coverage matrix
- **Q1 §1.5**: Updated auth status — Phase 1 marked complete (`@object-ui/auth` package exists with AuthProvider, useAuth, AuthGuard, forms, createAuthenticatedFetch)
- **Q1 §1.6** (new): `@objectstack/client` Low-Code Integration — dynamic app loading via `adapter.getApp()`, widget manifest system, data integration hardening
- **Q2 §2.6** (new): Full-stack integration — formula functions (SUM/AVG/TODAY/IF), report export with live data, server-side transaction support
- **Q3 §3.1**: Added real-time gap context from evaluation, offline queue item
- **Annual targets**: Added `Client Integration` metric row (92% → 95% → 100% → 100%)
- **References**: Linked evaluation document
